description: Spec intro claims sprint-3 'flips the production switch' so 'a real agent ... actually lands in the served aniccaai.com/dashboard leaderboard'. The live evidence log itself contradicts this: the deployed /dashboard-sync on main runs an older, un-enriched version, is_ours/earn_src/net_worth_src are all null on the live response. A real agent registering today shows up on aniccaai.com with no no-fake enrichment. This is disclosed in the evidence log's FOLLOW-UPS section (after the fact) but is NOT named anywhere in the spec's own 'Scope (out)' section, so a reader of the spec alone would believe S3.5 proves the full rollout outcome. Disclosure in an evidence log does not satisfy the requirement stated in the spec.
